rdfs:label: credentialStatus
rdfs:comment: A reference to a status mechanism for a VerifiableCredential — e.g. a revocation list — that verifiers consult to check whether the credential is still active.
notes: Distinct from expiration (a static date in the credential). Status is dynamic — the credential is signed once but can be revoked or suspended any time after. Current type: `BitstringStatusListEntry` (W3C Bitstring Status List v1.0, https://www.w3.org/ns/credentials/status#BitstringStatusListEntry); older: `StatusList2021Entry` (https://w3id.org/vc/status-list#StatusList2021Entry), `RevocationList2020Status`. Verifiers fetch the referenced status list and check the credential's bit/index.

history.note: Example status type corrected to BitstringStatusListEntry (non-existent cred:StatusList2021Entry removed); notes list current vs older status types.
